gate_definition: All model fitting, baselines, feature transforms and threshold choices must fit on train dates only unless validation-use is explicitly declared.
Validation date may select among predeclared families/thresholds only; no test-date feedback allowed.
Test date remains untouched until the replay runner has produced train/validation-only readiness evidence.
Future replay must bind Phase180 Zerodha cost catalog and retail/stressed latency profiles before any net result.
Future replay must scan candidate rules for overlap with Phase164, Phase167 and Phase131-136 blocked forms.
Future replay must include shuffled-time and shuffled-symbol negative controls before acceptance can be interpreted.
Future replay must abort promotion if only zero-latency/control rows are positive or if retail/stressed profiles are negative.
